apps.sub: An app's landing is the device its sound actually plays to. Only apps that are playing sound right now are listed.
apps.systemHint: System sounds always follow the default device.
apps.restart: Restart the app for this to take effect
apps.empty: No app is playing sound right now.
apps.unavailable: Can't read the apps' audio sessions.
apps.note: The choice is saved per app: from now on the app plays to the chosen device every time it starts. Some apps (such as Discord and some games) choose their own device and ignore this; set the device inside those apps.

tools.sub: Small helpers. They only change Windows settings, not the workbench.
tools.defaultsSub: Set the Windows default device and default communication device directly. Changes take effect right away. Aemeath doesn't remember or restore these settings.
tools.unavailable: Can't read the Windows audio devices.

wb.hint: Drag from a port to connect · Click a route, then press Del to delete · Right-click a route to show its label, then scroll over the label to change the gain

offline.exclusiveNotAllowed: Offline · Windows doesn't allow exclusive use of this device
offline.slotFailing: The virtual device can't be attached

node.notRunningHint: {program} isn't running. It connects by itself when it starts.

route.toggle: Turn the route from {src} to {dst} on or off
route.moveHint: Scroll to change the gain. Drag to slide this label along the route (Alt+← / Alt+→).

drag.hint: Drop on a node to connect · Esc to cancel
drag.selfRoute: A node can't connect to itself
drag.loop: Can't connect: this would create a loop

toast.deviceReplaced: {node} now uses the newly connected device with the same name: {device}

error.unavailable: The control plane is not running.
error.noFreeSlot: All 8 virtual devices of this direction are in use.
error.slotOccupied: That virtual device is already in use.
error.deviceInUse: This device already has a node.
error.notFound: The node or route no longer exists.
error.programInUse: This program already has an app source.
error.invalidProgram: Choose an .exe file with a full path.
error.hotkeyModifierRequired: A toggle hotkey on the keyboard needs Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win. Use Hold for a single key.
error.hotkeyToggleOnly: This action can only be a toggle.
error.hotkeyConflict: That key is already used for {object}.

add.title: Add node
add.noDevices: No available devices in this direction.
add.name: Name

kindHint.externalInput: A microphone or other recording device on this PC
kindHint.virtualInput: A virtual playback device that apps can play into
kindHint.bus: Sums what is sent into it and sends it on, without a device
kindHint.virtualOutput: A virtual recording device that apps such as OBS can record from
kindHint.externalOutput: Headphones, speakers or another playback device on this PC
kindHint.appSource: The sound of one program, wherever it's playing
kindHint.externalInsert: Sends sound through an external program, such as NVIDIA Broadcast, and takes it back
kindHint.recorder: Writes the sound routed into it to a file

add.appSourceNote: App sources add 30–60 ms of latency compared with landing the app directly on a virtual input, so they suit streaming better than live monitoring. Programs that play in exclusive mode can't be captured.
add.insertSend: Sound goes to the external program through {slot}. Set that device as the program's input.

dev.sub: Aemeath provides 16 fixed virtual device slots. A slot is plugged in automatically while a node occupies it and unplugged when no node does, so unused slots stay out of the Windows device list. Device names are fixed; the devices are removed only when Aemeath is uninstalled.
dev.driverUntested: This version is newer than the one bundled with Aemeath and has not been tested with it.
dev.outputsSub: Apps such as OBS record from these
dev.freeSub: Plugs in when a node uses it
dev.fmtSame: Same as the engine · no resampling
dev.fmtDiff: Differs from the engine sample rate · resampled
dev.fmtMismatch: Being applied, or the device does not accept this format
dev.note: Aemeath sets each virtual device to the engine sample rate when it is first plugged in. Changing a device format briefly disconnects any app that is using that device, such as OBS.

set.engineRateSub: The rate Aemeath mixes at. Devices at other rates are resampled.
set.resamplerSub: Used by every node that follows the global default. Affected nodes fade out and back in when you change it.
set.clockSub: The engine timeline follows this device's clock, so it needs no resampling; other external devices and app sources are aligned to it. With the system clock, every external device is resampled.
set.detectSub: Offline devices are re-detected automatically (for example when NVIDIA Broadcast is ready later than Aemeath). Use this button to try again right away.
set.foldersSub: Aemeath keeps its configuration, logs and cache here.
set.updateConfirm: Aemeath will restart and sound will stop for a few seconds.
set.autostartSub: Starts Aemeath when you sign in. It stays in the tray and does not open a window.
set.crashSub: Saves diagnostic files to the data folder when Aemeath crashes. Needs administrator rights once.
set.removeDevicesSub: Do this before deleting the portable folder. Needs administrator rights.
set.removeConfirm: Aemeath will quit and remove its 16 virtual devices. They are registered again the next time you start it.
set.accentSub: Used for buttons, selections and routes.
set.backgroundSub: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 40 MB. Aemeath keeps its own copy.
set.overlaySub: How much the image is dimmed so text stays readable.

reg.title: Preparing virtual devices
reg.body: Aemeath is setting up its 16 virtual devices. The first time, Windows installs a driver for each one, which can take about a minute.
reg.failing: Some devices can't be attached yet: {slots}. Aemeath keeps retrying.
reg.waitingEngine: Waiting for the engine to start…

preset.title: The workbench is empty
preset.body: Start from the workbench preset: a virtual input (apps play into it) and a virtual output (OBS and other apps record from it), with no routes. Or add your own nodes.

device.exclusiveHint: Only Aemeath uses the device, and the sound bypasses Windows' mixing and resampling. Other apps can't use it at the same time.
device.probing: Reading the formats the device supports…
device.probeFailed: Can't read the formats the device supports (it's missing or in use by another app). You can use the recommended format for now.
device.bufferHint: A smaller buffer means lower latency but more dropouts when the system is busy. A custom value is adjusted to the nearest value the device allows.
device.sharedHint: In shared mode Windows decides the device format, and other apps can use the device at the same time.
device.sharedFormat: In shared mode Windows decides the device format, currently {format}. Other apps can use the device at the same time.
device.resamplerGlobalHint: Uses the default resampler from Settings.

rate.title: Engine sample rate
rate.label: Sample rate
rate.body: Sound stops briefly while every device reopens. Nodes that follow the engine change format with it; nodes with a specified format keep theirs.
rate.recording: Recording stops first and does not resume.
rate.over384: Virtual devices cannot reach this rate. They run at 384 kHz and are resampled, which uses noticeably more CPU.

slot.followHint: The virtual device uses the engine sample rate, up to 384 kHz, with 32-bit integer samples.
slot.changeConfirm: Apps using this device will be briefly disconnected.

resampler.polyWarning: High-frequency distortion is high, and downsampling aliases.

mx.title: Route matrix
mx.empty: Add input and output nodes to see the routes between them here.
mx.idle: Hover a cell to see where the sound goes from and to.
mx.lgKeys: Click: create or toggle · Del: delete · Scroll over a cell: ±1 dB

con.title: Console
con.caption: Pinned nodes: {n}
con.empty: No pinned nodes yet. Use Pin node or a node's menu to put the nodes you adjust often here.

nodeSettings.title: Node settings: {name}
nodeSettings.slotHint: After you change the slot, apps need to use the new device name.
nodeSettings.gateHint: Closes this input while the signal is below the threshold. The far left of the slider turns the gate off.
nodeSettings.candidatesHint: The original device is gone, and several devices have the same name ({device}). Choose which one this node should use.
nodeSettings.insertHint: In the external program, set the input to {device}.

menu.resetLabel: Move the label back to the middle of the route

confirm.deleteLanding: {n} app(s) land on this node. After it's deleted, they'll follow the system default.

rec.sub: Each recorder node writes what is routed into it to a file in this folder. Recording continues when the main window restarts. WAV files are split automatically before they reach 4 GB.
rec.folderHint: Changing the folder does not move existing recordings.
rec.flacRateHint: FLAC files are limited to 96 kHz, so this recording is saved at 96 kHz (88.2 kHz for 44.1 kHz-based engine rates). WAV keeps the engine sample rate.
rec.empty: No recorder nodes yet. Add one on the workbench.

hotkey.sub: Global hotkeys work everywhere. Dedicated hotkeys belong to a node or route and are deleted with it. Hotkeys are unavailable briefly while the main program restarts.
hotkey.dedicatedEmpty: No dedicated hotkeys yet. Set them in node settings or from a route's menu.
hotkey.note: Hold inverts while the key is down and restores when it's released; it isn't saved. Toggle changes the saved state. Mouse side buttons work in both modes.
hotkey.hint: Click the field, then press the key. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
